# Oops, It’s Yesterday Twice More

Oops, It’s Yesterday Twice More
Input file: standard input
Output file: standard output
Time limit: 1 second
Memory limit: 256 megabytes
After the great success in 2018, 2019, and 2020, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
(NUAA) will host the International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) Nanjing regional for the
fourth time.
Team Power of Two and team Three Hold Two won the champion for Tsinghua University in 2018
and 2019. In 2020, team Inverted Cross from Peking University won the champion. In 2021, there are
around 700 teams including the defending champion participating in the contest. We are so excited
to see who will win this year!
Although we can’t gather in Nanjing this time due to the pandemic, we should still be grateful for the
hard work done by all staff and volunteers for this contest. Thank you all for your great contribution to
this contest!
The 2018 ICPC Asia Nanjing Regional Contest
In the 2018 contest, problem K, Kangaroo Puzzle, requires the contestants to construct an operation
sequence for the game:
The puzzle is a grid with n rows and m columns (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 20) and there are some (at least 2)
kangaroos standing in the puzzle. The player’s goal is to control them to get together. There are some
walls in some cells and the kangaroos cannot enter the cells with walls. The other cells are empty. The
kangaroos can move from an empty cell to an adjacent empty cell in four directions: up, down, left, and
right.
There is exactly one kangaroo in every empty cell in the beginning and the player can control the
kangaroos by pressing the button U, D, L, R on the keyboard. The kangaroos will move simultaneously
according to the button you press.
The contestant needs to construct an operating sequence of at most 5 × 104
steps consisting of U, D, L,
R only to achieve the goal.
Page 1 of 2

In the 2020 contest, problem A, Ah, It’s Yesterday Once More, requires the contestants to construct
an input map to hack the following code of the problem described before:
#include <b i t s / s t d c++.h>
using namespace s t d ;
s t r i n g s = "UDLR" ;
int main ( )
{
s rand ( time (NULL ) ) ;
for ( int i = 1 ; i <= 50000; i++) pu tcha r ( s [ rand ( ) % 4 ] ) ;
return 0 ;
}
Now in the 2021 contest, Paimon prepares another version of the problem for you. You are given a grid
with n rows and n columns (2 ≤ n ≤ 500). All cells are empty and there is one kangaroo standing in each
cell.
Similarly, you can control the kangaroos by pressing the button U, D, L, R on the keyboard. The kangaroos
will move simultaneously according to the button you press. Specifically, for any kangaroo located in the
cell on the i-th row and the j-th column, indicated by (i, j):
1. Button U: it will move to (i − 1, j) if i > 1. Otherwise, it will stay in the same grid.
2. Button D: it will move to (i + 1, j) if i < n. Otherwise, it will stay in the same grid.
3. Button L: it will move to (i, j − 1) if j > 1. Otherwise, it will stay in the same grid.
4. Button R: it will move to (i, j + 1) if j < n. Otherwise, it will stay in the same grid.
You need to construct an operating sequence consisting only of characters ‘U’, ‘D’, ‘L’, and ‘R’. After
applying it, you must make sure every kangaroo will gather at the specific cell (a, b). The length of the
operating sequence cannot exceed 3(n − 1).
Input
There is only one test case in each test file.
The first and only line of the input contains three integers n, a, b (2 ≤ n ≤ 500, 1 ≤ a, b ≤ n) indicating
the size of the grid and the target cell.
Output
Output a string consisting only of characters ‘U’, ‘D’, ‘L’ and ‘R’ in one line. And its length mustn’t
exceed 3(n − 1). It can be proved that the answer always exists.

standard input standard output
3 3 3 RRDD
4 3 2 DLDLDLUR

# Oops, It's Yesterday Twice More

## Description

After the great success in 2018, 2019 and 2020, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics (NUAA) hosts the International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) Nanjing regional for the fourth time.

Team Power of Two and team Three Hold Two from Tsinghua University won in 2018 and 2019. In 2020, team Inverted Cross from Peking University won. In 2021, about 700 teams, including the defending champion, participate. We are excited to see who wins this year!

Although we cannot gather in Nanjing this time due to the pandemic, we should still be grateful for all staff and volunteers' hard work. Thank you for your great contribution to the contest!

![Original figure](103470-A-figure1.png)

The 2018 ICPC Asia Nanjing Regional Contest.

In the 2018 contest, problem K, Kangaroo Puzzle, asked contestants to construct an operation sequence for the following game:

The puzzle is a grid with $n$ rows and $m$ columns ($1\le n,m\le20$), containing at least $2$ kangaroos. The player must make them gather. Some cells are walls that cannot be entered; all others are empty. A kangaroo can move to an adjacent empty cell in one of four directions: up, down, left and right.

Initially, exactly one kangaroo stands in each empty cell. Press U, D, L or R to move all kangaroos simultaneously in that direction.

Contestants must construct a sequence of at most $5\times10^4$ operations using only U, D, L and R to reach the goal.

In the 2020 contest, problem A, Ah, It's Yesterday Once More, asked contestants to construct an input map that hacks the following code for the previous problem:

```cpp
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
string s = "UDLR";
int main() {
    srand(time(NULL));
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50000; i++) putchar(s[rand() % 4]);
    return 0;
}
```

Now, in the 2021 contest, Paimon prepares another version. You are given an $n\times n$ grid ($2\le n\le500$). Every cell is empty, and each cell initially contains one kangaroo.

As before, U, D, L and R move all kangaroos simultaneously. For a kangaroo in row $i$, column $j$, denoted by $(i,j)$:

1. U: move to $(i-1,j)$ if $i>1$; otherwise stay.
2. D: move to $(i+1,j)$ if $i<n$; otherwise stay.
3. L: move to $(i,j-1)$ if $j>1$; otherwise stay.
4. R: move to $(i,j+1)$ if $j<n$; otherwise stay.

Construct a string consisting only of U, D, L and R, of length at most $3(n-1)$, so that after applying it every kangaroo gathers at the target cell $(a,b)$.

## Input

There is exactly one test case in each input file.

The only line contains three integers $n,a,b$ ($2\le n\le500$, $1\le a,b\le n$), giving the grid size and target cell.

## Output

Output one line containing a string consisting only of U, D, L and R, of length at most $3(n-1)$. It can be proved that an answer always exists.

### Sample 1

#### Input

```text
3 3 3
```

#### Output

```text
RRDD
```

### Sample 2

#### Input

```text
4 3 2
```

#### Output

```text
DLDLDLUR
```

translation.markdown:
# Oops, It's Yesterday Twice More

## 题目描述

继 2018 年、2019 年和 2020 年比赛取得成功后，南京航空航天大学（NUAA）第四次承办国际大学生程序设计竞赛（ICPC）南京区域赛。

清华大学的 Power of Two 队和 Three Hold Two 队分别在 2018 年与 2019 年获得冠军；2020 年的冠军则是北京大学的 Inverted Cross 队。2021 年，约有 700 支队伍参赛，其中包括卫冕冠军。我们非常期待今年的冠军归属！

虽然这次由于疫情无法相聚南京，我们仍应感谢所有工作人员和志愿者的辛勤工作。感谢大家为本次比赛作出的贡献！

![原稿配图](103470-A-figure1.png)

2018 ICPC 亚洲区域赛南京站。

2018 年比赛的 K 题 Kangaroo Puzzle 要求选手为下面的游戏构造操作序列：

棋盘是一个 $n$ 行 $m$ 列的网格（$1\le n,m\le20$），其中至少有 $2$ 只袋鼠。玩家需要让它们聚到一起。一些格子为不能进入的墙，其余格子为空格。袋鼠可以向上、下、左、右四个方向移动到相邻空格。

初始时，每个空格中恰好有一只袋鼠。按下 U、D、L 或 R，所有袋鼠就会同时向对应方向移动。

选手需要构造一个仅由 U、D、L、R 组成、长度不超过 $5\times10^4$ 的操作序列来达成目标。

2020 年比赛的 A 题 Ah, It's Yesterday Once More 则要求选手构造一张输入地图，使下面这个解决上述问题的程序出错：

```cpp
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
string s = "UDLR";
int main() {
    srand(time(NULL));
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50000; i++) putchar(s[rand() % 4]);
    return 0;
}
```

现在，在 2021 年的比赛中，Paimon 为你准备了另一个版本：给定一个 $n\times n$ 的网格（$2\le n\le500$），所有格子都是空格，初始时每个格子中恰好有一只袋鼠。

和之前一样，U、D、L、R 会同时控制所有袋鼠移动。对于位于第 $i$ 行、第 $j$ 列，即 $(i,j)$ 的袋鼠：

1. U：若 $i>1$，则移动到 $(i-1,j)$；否则留在原地。
2. D：若 $i<n$，则移动到 $(i+1,j)$；否则留在原地。
3. L：若 $j>1$，则移动到 $(i,j-1)$；否则留在原地。
4. R：若 $j<n$，则移动到 $(i,j+1)$；否则留在原地。

请构造一个仅由 U、D、L、R 组成、长度不超过 $3(n-1)$ 的字符串，使执行完操作后所有袋鼠都聚集在目标格子 $(a,b)$。

## 输入格式

每个输入文件只有一组测试数据。

唯一一行包含三个整数 $n,a,b$（$2\le n\le500$，$1\le a,b\le n$），表示网格大小和目标格子。

## 输出格式

输出一行，仅包含 U、D、L、R 组成的字符串，长度不能超过 $3(n-1)$。可以证明答案一定存在。

### 样例 1

#### 输入

```text
3 3 3
```

#### 输出

```text
RRDD
```

### 样例 2

#### 输入

```text
4 3 2
```

#### 输出

```text
DLDLDLUR
```

notes: Both original pages visually reviewed; photograph and historical random code retained.
The actual 2021 grid is all-empty n by n with n<=500; historical 2018 restrictions must not leak into this variant.
All four boundary conditions and 3(n-1) length cap checked.
